mechanism: Vitamin C (ascorbic acid) enhances potassium absorption in the gastrointestinal tract and may increase serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those taking potassium-elevating medications.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels in patients receiving concurrent potassium supplementation and high-dose vitamin C, especially those with renal disease or ACE inhibitor/ARB use; adjust potassium dosing as needed.
